units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 55:23">Targ. Ps. LV, 23</cite>; <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Lamentations 2:1">Targ. Lam. II, 1</cite>; a. fr. (h. text <he>השליך</he>).—
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 75">Gen. R. s. 75</cite> <he>שלח … וטַלְקֵיה וכ׳</he> he took off the purple cloak and threw it down before him.
Y. Yeb. XII, 12ᵈ top; Y. Sabb. VI, 8ᵃ bot. [read:] טלקיה לחנותא דחליטרא pitched it into a confectioner’s shop. [Targ. Y. II, Ex. XXI, 18, v. Ithpa.]
Targ. Ps. LI, 13 (ed. Lag. Pe.).—Y. Sabb. l. c. מְטַלֵּק לה; (Y. Yeb. l. c. מסלק). Y. Keth. XII, 35ᵃ טליק גרמיה threw himself down; (Y. Kil. IX, 32ᵇ top טְלַק); a. e.—Part. pass. מְטַלַּק.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Leviticus 17:15">Targ. Y. Lev. XVII, 15</cite>.—Y. Snh. VII, end, 25ᵈ <he>דאינון מְטַלְּקִין בימא</he> they have been thrown into the sea.

<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:1">Lam. R. to I, 1</cite> <cite ref="T00152"><he>רבתי</he></cite> (<he>חד מאת׳</he> 3) <cite ref="M01018"><he>מְטַלְּקָא</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="M00265"><he>מְדוֹכָא</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: to be thrown, to be cast away.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 3:4">Targ. Job III, 4</cite>, v. <cite ref="A01096"><he>אִטְלָקוּתָא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jerusalem, Exodus 21:18">Targ. Y. II, Ex. XXI, 18</cite> [read:] <he>ויִטַּלַּק</he>, or <he>ויִטְּלֵיק</he> (h. text <he>נפל</he>).
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 22:11">Targ. Ps. XXII, 11</cite>.—Y. Sot. V, 20ᵇ bot. <he>א׳ עלוי</he> it was thrown upon him, i.e. a penalty was imposed &c.
